levels.description:
Destroys itself along with the Operator when equipped, then refreshes the Dispatch Center, offering two Operators of the same Tier as the equipped Operator; one can be picked for free
<@ba.rem>If there are Teammates present within the Team Simulation, a copy of the original Operator will be sent to the Teammate with the most corresponding Alliance members during the next Rest Phase</>
<@ba.acrem>If multiple Teammates fulfill this condition, the copy will be sent to a random Teammate</>
<@ba.acrem>Cannot be equipped by Custom Operators</>
